exercises.name: Dumbbell Bench Press
instructions: Lie back on a flat bench with a dumbbell in each hand at chest level.
Press the dumbbells up until your arms are straight over your shoulders.
Lower under control until your elbows pass just below bench level.
Keep your feet planted and shoulder blades pinched together.
tips: Keep your wrists stacked over your elbows throughout the lift.

exercises.name: Barbell Bench Press
instructions: Lie on the bench with eyes under the bar and grip slightly wider than shoulders.
Unrack the bar and lower it to your mid-chest with elbows at about 45 degrees.
Press the bar back up until your arms are locked out.
Keep your feet flat and your upper back tight on the bench.
tips: Use a spotter or safety arms when training close to failure.

exercises.name: Incline Dumbbell Press
instructions: Set the bench to a 30 degree incline and sit back with dumbbells on your thighs.
Kick the weights up to shoulder height with palms facing forward.
Press up and slightly inward until your arms are straight.
Lower slowly until you feel a stretch across your upper chest.
tips: A 30 degree angle works the upper chest without turning it into a shoulder press.

exercises.name: Push-Up
instructions: Start in a high plank with hands just wider than your shoulders.
Lower your chest toward the floor, keeping your body in one straight line.
Push the floor away until your arms are straight.
Elevate your hands on a bench to make it easier.
tips: Squeeze your glutes and brace your abs so your hips don't sag.

exercises.name: Cable Fly
instructions: Set both pulleys at chest height and step forward with a staggered stance.
With a slight bend in your elbows, bring your hands together in front of your chest.
Pause and squeeze, then open your arms slowly until you feel a stretch.
Keep your torso still throughout.
tips: Think about hugging a barrel rather than pressing the handles.

exercises.name: Seated Cable Row
instructions: Sit tall with feet on the platform and knees slightly bent.
Pull the handle to your lower ribs, driving your elbows back.
Squeeze your shoulder blades together for a second.
Return slowly until your arms are straight without rounding your back.
tips: Lead with your elbows, not your hands, and avoid swinging your torso.

exercises.name: Lat Pulldown
instructions: Grip the bar slightly wider than shoulder width and secure your thighs under the pad.
Lean back a few degrees and pull the bar to your upper chest.
Squeeze your lats at the bottom.
Let the bar rise slowly until your arms are fully extended.
tips: Pull your elbows down toward your hips rather than yanking with your arms.

exercises.name: Barbell Row
instructions: Hinge at the hips with a flat back and the bar hanging below your knees.
Pull the bar to your lower ribs, keeping your elbows close.
Pause briefly at the top.
Lower under control without letting your back round.
tips: Keep your torso angle fixed so your back, not momentum, does the work.

exercises.name: Pull-Up
instructions: Hang from the bar with an overhand grip just wider than your shoulders.
Pull your chest toward the bar by driving your elbows down.
Pause with your chin above the bar.
Lower to a full hang under control.
tips: Use a resistance band or an assisted machine if you can't yet reach the target reps.

exercises.name: Face Pull
instructions: Set the cable at upper-chest height with a rope attachment.
Pull the rope toward your face, splitting the ends past your ears.
Squeeze your rear delts and rotate your hands outward.
Return slowly with control.
tips: Use a light weight; this is for shoulder health and posture, not ego.

exercises.name: Overhead Press
instructions: Stand tall with the weight at shoulder height and your core braced.
Press straight overhead until your arms are locked out.
Move your head slightly forward once the weight passes your forehead.
Lower back to your shoulders under control.
tips: Squeeze your glutes to avoid leaning back and overarching your lower back.

exercises.name: Lateral Raises
instructions: Stand with a light dumbbell in each hand at your sides.
Raise your arms out to the sides until they reach shoulder height.
Lead with your elbows with a slight bend in the arms.
Lower slowly over about two seconds.
tips: Go lighter than you think and stop at shoulder height to keep tension on the delts.

exercises.name: Biceps Curl
instructions: Stand with a dumbbell in each hand, palms facing forward.
Curl the weights up while keeping your elbows pinned to your sides.
Squeeze at the top.
Lower fully over two to three seconds.
tips: Avoid swinging your torso; if you need momentum, the weight is too heavy.

exercises.name: Hammer Curl
instructions: Hold dumbbells at your sides with palms facing each other.
Curl up without rotating your wrists.
Pause at the top, then lower under control.
tips: Keep your elbows still to maximise tension on the brachialis.

exercises.name: Triceps Pushdown
instructions: Stand facing the cable with elbows tucked at your sides.
Push the handle down until your arms are fully straight.
Squeeze your triceps, then let your hands rise to chest height.
Keep your upper arms still throughout.
tips: Don't let your elbows flare or drift forward.

exercises.name: Barbell Back Squat
instructions: Set the bar across your upper back and step out with feet shoulder-width apart.
Brace your core and sit down and back until your thighs are at least parallel.
Keep your knees tracking over your toes and chest up.
Drive through your whole foot to stand.
tips: Take a big breath into your belly and brace before every rep.

exercises.name: Goblet Squat
instructions: Hold a dumbbell vertically against your chest with elbows pointing down.
Squat down between your knees, keeping your chest tall.
Pause at the bottom with elbows inside your knees.
Stand back up by driving through your heels.
tips: A great way to learn squat depth and posture before loading a barbell.

exercises.name: Romanian Deadlift
instructions: Stand tall holding the weight in front of your thighs.
Push your hips straight back with knees slightly bent and a flat back.
Lower until you feel a deep hamstring stretch, around mid-shin.
Drive your hips forward to return to standing.
tips: Keep the weight close to your legs the whole way down and up.

exercises.name: Conventional Deadlift
instructions: Stand with the bar over mid-foot and grip just outside your knees.
Brace your core, flatten your back, and push the floor away.
Keep the bar against your legs until you lock out your hips and knees.
Lower by hinging your hips back, then bending your knees.
tips: Think 'push the floor away' rather than 'pull the bar up'.

exercises.name: Leg Press
instructions: Sit with your back flat against the pad and feet shoulder-width on the platform.
Lower the sled until your knees reach about 90 degrees.
Press through your whole foot without locking your knees at the top.
tips: Don't let your lower back peel off the seat at the bottom.

exercises.name: Walking Lunge
instructions: Stand tall, holding a dumbbell in each hand if desired.
Step forward and lower until both knees are around 90 degrees.
Push through your front foot and step through into the next lunge.
Reps are counted per leg.
tips: Take a long enough step that your front shin stays roughly vertical.

exercises.name: Leg Curl
instructions: Adjust the pad so it rests just above your heels.
Curl your heels toward your glutes.
Squeeze at the top, then return slowly.
tips: Take about three seconds to lower the weight for more hamstring tension.

exercises.name: Standing Calf Raise
instructions: Stand with the balls of your feet on a step and heels hanging off.
Rise as high as you can onto your toes.
Pause at the top, then lower into a deep stretch.
tips: Use full range of motion and pause at both the top and the bottom.

exercises.name: Hip Thrust
instructions: Sit with your upper back against a bench and the weight across your hips.
Drive through your heels to lift your hips until your torso is level.
Squeeze your glutes hard at the top.
Lower under control and repeat.
tips: Tuck your chin and keep your ribs down so your glutes, not your lower back, do the work.

exercises.name: Glute Bridge
instructions: Lie on your back with knees bent and feet flat on the floor.
Press through your heels and lift your hips until your body forms a straight line.
Squeeze your glutes for a second, then lower slowly.
tips: Stop when your hips are level; going higher only arches your lower back.

exercises.name: Plank
instructions: Rest on your forearms with elbows under your shoulders.
Keep your body in a straight line from head to heels.
Brace your abs, squeeze your glutes, and breathe steadily.
tips: Stop the set when your hips start to sag or pike.

exercises.name: Dead Bug
instructions: Lie on your back with arms pointing up and knees bent at 90 degrees over your hips.
Slowly lower the opposite arm and leg toward the floor.
Keep your lower back pressed into the floor.
Return and switch sides.
tips: Move slowly; if your back arches off the floor, shorten the range.

exercises.name: Farmer's Carry
instructions: Pick up a heavy dumbbell in each hand and stand tall.
Walk with short, controlled steps for the target time.
Keep your shoulders back and don't lean to either side.
tips: Choose a weight that challenges your grip but lets you keep perfect posture.

exercises.name: Kettlebell Swing
instructions: Stand with feet wider than your shoulders and the kettlebell on the floor in front of you.
Hike the bell back between your legs, then snap your hips forward.
Let the bell float to chest height; your arms just guide it.
Control the descent and hinge back into the next rep.
tips: Power comes from your hips; the swing is a hinge, not a squat.

exercises.name: World's Greatest Stretch
instructions: Step into a deep lunge and place both hands inside your front foot.
Rotate your torso and reach the inside arm toward the ceiling.
Return your hand to the floor, straighten the front leg, and pull your toes up.
Repeat on the other side.
tips: Move slowly and breathe out as you rotate.

exercises.name: Cat-Cow
instructions: Start on all fours with hands under shoulders and knees under hips.
Inhale and drop your belly while lifting your chest and tailbone.
Exhale and round your spine, tucking your chin and tailbone.
Flow slowly between the two positions.
tips: Let your breathing set the pace.
